meaning: A feature that lets chosen people see where your phone is on a map. You decide who sees it and for how long.
clues: It has something to do with where you are.
It uses a map and the position of your phone.
It sends your spot to friends or family you pick, so they can follow along on a trip.
You can stop it any time, or set it to end after an hour.
It has two words. The first starts with L, and the second means letting others have a turn.
assumes: GPS is a system of satellites that helps a device find where it is
Street view shows photos of streets on a map
A compass has a needle that points north

decoys.meaning: A system of satellites that lets a device work out where it is.
Photos of streets, taken by cameras on vehicles, that you can look around in on a map.
A tool with a needle that points north.

exchange.text: In my day we said, "Call me when you get there." Then we sat by the phone and watched the clock.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Tip: share with family for just one trip, like the drive home. Then turn it off when you arrive.
